## WF1 – Collect and clean
Apify Google Maps run (started in the Apify console): 48 searches = 12 Berlin districts × 4 keywords, max 25 places each.
This workflow fetches the results, removes closed and non-Berlin places, dedupes on place ID → domain → phone, maps postcodes to districts and writes the leads to the sheet.
**985 raw results → 758 unique companies**
